issue.title: [xCluster] Replication fails with 'Error: Network error (yb/util/net/socket.cc:535): Unable to alter replication for universe XXXXX: recvmsg got EOF from remote (system error 108)'

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-2232](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-2232)
**Issue**
When the `Master Leader` is on a node, that is not is the `masterAddrs` under the `producerMap`, any `alter_universe_replication` command failed with the following error message: 

```
[yugabyte@yb-dev-zd-1197-primary-n4 bin]$ ./yb-admin --master_addresses 10.204.0.7,10.204.0.8,10.204.0.9 alter_universe_replication fa98841d-6609-4e11-8d50-055befa9b535 add_table 5cfce69350ca4ae2a0f159634b472985
Error: Network error (yb/util/net/socket.cc:535): Unable to alter replication for universe fa98841d-6609-4e11-8d50-055befa9b535: recvmsg got EOF from remote (system error 108)
```

**Steps to reproduce** 
1. Setup xCluster replication 
2. From the Yugaware platform UI, stop all services on the `MasterLeader`/`Tserver` node 
3. Start the `Master` process on a `TServer` node
4. From the CLI - issue, change the master - where the new `masterLeader` is the node that was only a `tserver` prior. 
```
yb-admin -master_addresses <master-addresses> master_leader_stepdown [ <new_leader_id> ]
``` 
5. Attempt to add bidirectional-replication for a new table 
```
yb-admin master_addresses <master-addresses> alter_universe_replication <producer_universe_uuid> { set_master_addresses <producer_master_addresses> |  add_table <table_id>[, <table_id>...] | remove_table <table_id>[, <table_id>...] }
```

**Request**
Platform needs to update map when master leader changes 


Please see reference ticket: [1197](https://yugabyte.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/1197)

body: Link to platform issue - platform should be aware of replication https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/8325

issue.title: [xCluster][Platform] Replication Lag sets to erroneous value when producer map is behind

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
**Issue** 
This bug is related to bugs [8772](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/8772), [7807](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/7807) and [8325](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/8325) 

When a customer finds themself in a situation where the producer/consumer map values are outdated, they can create an error that causes the reported replication lag to spike - stating replication is YEARS behind. 

- Yugabyte 2.4.4-b7 

**Steps to reproduce** 
1. Follow steps in github issue [8325](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/8325)  to create the condition where cluster master addresses and replication map values are inconsistent. 
2. Ensure Replication already exists and is working for tables in a keyspace. 
3. Create new table in existing YCQL keyspace on both clusters 
4. Attempt to add the table to existing replication relationship 
```
[yugabyte@yb-dev-hamilton-prometheus-rca-timeskew-n4 bin]$ ./yb-admin -master_addresses 10.200.0.83,10.204.0.44,10.207.0.39 alter_universe_replication e3baaff6-d0cb-4543-89e6-2f502f5608b4 add_table 2001ecc2ecb848fdbf20305817c9f419 
Error: Network error (yb/util/net/socket.cc:535): Unable to alter replication for universe e3baaff6-d0cb-4543-89e6-2f502f5608b4: recvmsg got EOF from remote (system error 108)
```
5. Observe results in UI, viewing the producer/universe where the alter replication command was run 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8861478/122323924-e4734100-cef5-11eb-8318-c66b74fddb23.png)

**Request** 
As we work to address replication management, and provide more guardrails and tooling, we need to have the cluster ignore these types of actions, when the replication map is in an erred state. 

**Reference** 
Please see ticket [1442](https://yugabyte.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/1442)

body: @streddy-yb @bmatican   - while we have our eye and minds on Replication issues as a whole I want to be sure that we can get this addressed as well for the issues we are hitting from the other GHIs related to replication :)

issue.title: [Platform] Update replication map when cluster master addresses are changed

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Currently when the master addresses of a cluster are changed, the producer/consumer map master addresses are not updated, causing various bugs with replication (#8951, #7807, #8325, #8772, etc).

Need to find places in codebase where master addresses are updated and update the replication maps as well to prevent the above issues.

issue.title: [xcluster] Automatically update consumer view of producer master addresses in the event of quorum changes

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: This is an enhancement of an existing feature

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-2420](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-2420)
When the producer master quorum changes, the consumer does not get notified. We need an explicit alter_universe_replication to be run by a human.

We should figure out if we can automate this at the DB level. One offline conversation was around
- piggybacking on the fact that in the producer cluster, the tservers get notified, via master heartbeat response, of any master quorum changes
- future GetChanges calls, from a consumer to a producer, could get some new quorum information as a response
- the consumer can then auto update the replication info, based on these
- TBD on making sure we don't send too much metadata in the GetChanges response, in case of more idle clusters...
